title: bisonR 1.0.0
text: Fixed effects names ending 1 (e.g. age1) dropped model (#80). Effort columns digits names, column names containing ., now also handled correctly. undirected networks, data rows -B B-now treated dyad. Conjugate models now use rows dyad data disaggregated. Previously last row used. Node metrics extract_metric() bison_to_igraph() now always returned order node levels, node names column names. Previously order differ one bison_brm() assumed input data weren’t sorted (#63). zero-inflation probability now bounded 0 1 (#77), posterior predictions log-likelihoods now include zero inflation. extract_metric(standardise = TRUE) now centres within posterior draw, documented. Mixture model components now ordered means posterior draw, avoid label switching. global_diameter now uses 1/weight edge length, consistent betweenness closeness. global_clustering[t] 0 connected triples, consistent node_clustering[t]. simulate_bison_model() put true age_diff, age_1 age_2 values wrong columns df_true. simulated data df_sim true edge weights affected. simulate_bison_model_mixture() longer returns age_diff, age_1, age_2 location columns, never simulated contained values. prior_check() now shows correct density binary edge priors probability scale. node_degree[t] now counts edges weight t, documented. model_comparison() now works models different numbers posterior draws, accounts autocorrelation MCMC draws. get_edge_component_probabilities() get_component_means() check num_components, simulate_bison_model() checks model_type, bison_brm() accepts backend argument.

title: bisonR 1.0.0
text: bisonR now requires R 4.1.0 later. cmdstanr longer attached library(bisonR). brms mice moved Suggests needed bison_brm(), bison_brm_get_prior() bison_mice(). undirected networks, node_1 get_edgelist() now node comes first node levels. Numeric node IDs written full (never scientific notation), integer decimal columns IDs give nodes. node columns aren’t factors levels, nodes ordered numerically names numbers, otherwise alphabetically locale-independent order (upper case lower case), results every computer. one node column factor, unused levels now kept. extract_metric(obj, "edge_weight") returns edge weights natural scale default. Use transform = FALSE link scale. bison_brm() still uses link scale. Conjugate models now give error formula includes fixed effects, random effects intercept. Random effects now centred 0, random_mean prior removed (prior lists include give warning). Previously random effect estimated mean, overlapped edge weights overall level depended priors. Models random effects dyad() term factor fixed effect need explicit intercept, e.g. (event | effort) ~ 1 + (1 | group), give warning without one. bison_save() writes single .rds file, filename argument now file. bison_load() can still load models saved earlier versions. convert_gbi_to_bison() uses column names GBI matrix node names, , rather column numbers. get_edge_component_probabilities() columns named P(component 1), P(component 2), …, get_component_means() rows Component 1, Component 2, …. simulate_bison_model() count data variation edges, smaller age-difference effect. Simulated data now effort column observation effort, documentation uses (event | effort). duration column kept copy effort, existing code still works (#64).
